name: PDF文本提取
desc: 从PDF文件中提取全部文本内容，保留段落结构
desc_en: Extract all text content from PDF files, preserving paragraph structure
input_en: PDF file URL or local path
output: 结构化文本字符串，包含页码映射
output_en: Structured text string with page mapping
usageGuide:
1. 安装PyMuPDF: pip install pymupdf
2. 启动MCP服务: python -m pymupdf_server
3. 调用端点: mcp://pymupdf-server/extract-text
usageGuide_en:
1. Install PyMuPDF: pip install pymupdf
2. Start MCP server: python -m pymupdf_server
3. Call endpoint: mcp://pymupdf-server/extract-text
